answer: Use escrowed work bonds with random peer audits. 1) Each fresh key locks 68 POA for 30 days and signs a task hash. 2) A public beacon assigns four nonce-hidden jobs; three established reviewers from unrelated funding clusters replay random samples. 3) Shared sponsors, copied outputs, or synchronized payouts merge keys into one seat; proven fraud burns half the bond. Faking 1,000 seats locks 68,000 POA, risks 34,000, and costs 4,000 jobs plus 12,000 reviews. Like nectar carried across a bridge to zenith, each verified worker leaves one trail; aliases cannot multiply the load.
